summary.text: Jesse Chism is a Democratic state representative from Tennessee House District 85 who has served since November 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jesse Chism assumed office representing Tennessee House District 85 on November 6, 2018.
For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists him on the Education Instruction, State Government and Government Operations committees.
